description: Add discovery and organization tooling to the Board view that mature apps rely on: a search box, filters (priority, tag, status), sort options, and a fast inline 'quick add' input. These operate on the enriched task data from FEAT-002. Keep the Kanban drag-and-drop intact; search/filter/sort narrow which cards are shown per column.
steps: In index.html, populate the currently-empty .board-actions area in #items-view header with: a search input (id 'board-search'), a priority filter select, a tag filter select (populated dynamically from existing task tags), and a sort select (Due date / Priority / Created / Title). Style with existing form-control look.

Add a quick-add input row above or below the kanban columns (id 'quick-add-input') that creates a 'todo' task from just a title on Enter, using normalizeTask defaults, then re-renders. This mirrors Todoist/Things quick capture.

In app.js, introduce board filter/sort state variables (searchTerm, filterPriority, filterTag, sortBy) and a `getVisibleTasks()` helper that applies search (title/description/tags/notes match), filters, and sort. renderBoard should render from getVisibleTasks() per status column. Update column counts to reflect filtered counts vs totals sensibly (show filtered count).
Wire input/change listeners in setupEventListeners for search, filters, sort, and quick-add. Debounce or directly re-render on input for search.
Populate the tag filter <select> dynamically from the union of all tags across tasks whenever the board renders (preserve current selection).
Add CSS for the board actions toolbar (search + selects laid out responsively) and the quick-add row, matching the theme; ensure it collapses gracefully on mobile (stack vertically).
Bump the style.css cache-busting query (?v=) in index.html.
acceptance_criteria: Typing in the search box narrows visible cards across all columns to those matching title/description/tags/notes (case-insensitive) in real time.
Selecting a priority or tag filter shows only matching tasks; selecting a sort option reorders cards within columns accordingly.
Typing a title in quick-add and pressing Enter creates a new todo task, clears the input, and the card appears immediately and persists to localStorage.
Drag-and-drop between columns still updates status and persists (when SortableJS is available).
`node --check app.js` exits 0 and no console errors occur while searching/filtering/sorting/quick-adding.
verification: Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8000`; create several tasks with varied priority/tags/dates; verify search, each filter, each sort option, and quick-add; verify drag-drop still works; confirm no console errors.
findings: Implemented board discovery toolbar (search #board-search, priority filter #board-filter-priority, dynamic tag filter #board-filter-tag, sort #board-sort) plus quick-add input #quick-add-input above the kanban columns. Added board state vars (searchTerm, filterPriority, filterTag, sortBy) and getVisibleTasks() applying case-insensitive search over title/description/tags/notes, priority+tag filters, and dueDate/priority/created/title sort. renderBoard now renders from getVisibleTasks() and column .task-count shows the filtered count; populateTagFilter() rebuilds the tag select from the union of all task tags each render and preserves the current selection (falls back to 'all' if the tag no longer exists). Listeners wired in setupEventListeners re-render the board on input/change; quick-add creates a normalizeTask({title,status:'todo'}) on Enter, clears the input, and persists via saveAndRender(). SortableJS drag-drop untouched and still guarded. Added responsive CSS for the toolbar and quick-add row (stack vertically under 768px) and reduced .kanban-board desktop height to account for the new toolbar/quick-add rows. Bumped style.css cache-bust to ?v=1.8.0. Verification: `NODE_OPTIONS= node --check app.js` exits 0. Ran headless via agent-browser against python3 http.server: seeded tasks confirmed search, priority filter, tag filter, priority sort, dynamic tag options, filtered column counts (todo=2/doing=1), quick-add persistence + input clear, and zero window 'error' events during interactions. Note: bare `node --check` fails in this sandbox due to an unrelated proxy preload; the `NODE_OPTIONS=` prefix is required. No em dashes used.
